crossRefs.note: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

translations.web: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
translations.bsb: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
translations.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
translations.asv: But he saith, Nay; lest haply while ye gather up the tares, ye root up the wheat with them.
